notes: Version 4.1.6. Bug fixes and improvements: per-user traffic usage now counts correctly (attribution fix); Clash/mihomo/FlClash subscription import no longer errors (YAML quoting); Nova Radar 'Apply' now saves scanned clean IPs into the panel; WireGuard now uses a maintained clean-endpoint pool (IRNova/Tools/warp-endpoints.txt) with a working default instead of the Iran-blocked engage; custom-domain self-update error codes fixed; Secure DNS (DoH) self-test fixed; Silent Alerts now persist and gate the login notification; a Decoy/speed-test target is configurable from the panel. Plus earlier security hardening (closed the unauthenticated install-recovery routes, pinned auto-update, constant-time secret compares) and a new in-panel Guide + FAQ. No wrangler/binding changes; existing configs and connections are unaffected.
